name: IREN

source.quote: As of June 30, 2026, the Group’s unsatisfied remaining performance obligations under ASC 606 and the aggregate contracted value of lease arrangements under ASC 842 totaled approximately $16.6 billion.

description: Former bitcoin miner (Iris Energy) turned AI cloud, renting Nvidia GPUs from its own powered data centers in Texas and Canada.
explain: IREN converted cheap power and bitcoin-mining sites into AI data centers and signed big GPU rental deals with Microsoft and Nvidia. Nvidia is both its chip supplier and a customer, and holds rights to invest up to $2.1 billion.
